# mf2-locale-data: CLDR number data for every CLDR locale (plans/05-tooling.md §7).
# Generated by `cargo xtask locale-data` from the `cargo xtask cldr-sync` cache (every
# locale's cldr-numbers-full/main/<locale>/numbers.json, parentLocales.json) and
# third_party/cldr-json (numberingSystems.json, likelySubtags.json). Do not edit.
# Lines: digits <nu> <0–9> · likely <lang[-REGION]> <Script> · parent <locale> <parent>
# · locale <tag> key=value… · system <tag> <nu> key=value… — a locale's fields that
# differ from its parent's (CLDR's resolved data, deduplicated). `\u{…}` escapes
# spaces, controls, format characters, `=` and `\`. Format: src/number/table.rs.
cldr 48.2.1
